附件预览已失效，请重新审核发送。: Attachment preview expired. Review the message again.
无法下载原邮件附件，请重新读取邮件后重试。: Unable to download the original attachment. Reload the message and try again.
附件上传失败，请刷新草稿后重试。: Attachment upload failed. Refresh the draft and try again.
草稿有尚未保存的修改。放弃修改并切换任务？: Discard unsaved draft changes and switch tasks?
把时间留给判断，其余交给自动处理。: Focus on decisions. Let workflows handle the rest.
每封邮件的处理进度，都清晰可追溯。: Track the progress of every message.
定义处理方式，让每一次自动执行都有章可循。: Define how incoming mail should be handled.
查看后台检测、任务执行与发送结果。: Review mailbox checks, task execution and send results.
配置邮箱与方案后，即可开始: Configure a mailbox and workflow to get started
后台正在检测邮箱，请稍后查看结果: Mailbox check is running. Results will appear shortly.
邮件服务尚未就绪，请先在邮件插件中配置邮箱账号。: Mail service is not ready. Configure an account in the email plugin.
后台任务服务尚未就绪；已有任务和方案仍可查看，请检查实例运行状态。: The background worker is not ready. Existing tasks and workflows remain available; check the running instance.
DSH 执行服务尚未就绪；方案和待办可查看，自动生成将等待服务恢复。: DSH execution is not ready. Tasks and workflows remain available; generation will resume when the service is ready.
请检查服务连接后刷新重试。: Check the service connection, then refresh to try again.
试试其他关键词或状态。: Try another search term or status.
后台会按方案处理新邮件，需要你审核时会出现在这里。: New mail is processed by your workflows. Tasks needing review appear here.
创建一个方案，自动整理邮件并准备回复草稿。: Create a workflow to organize incoming mail and prepare reply drafts.
请先保存草稿修改，再读取原邮件: Save draft changes before loading the message
点击“读取原邮件”查看正文，无需启动自动处理。: Select “Load message” to view the body. Automatic processing can stay paused.
这封邮件包含附件，读取原邮件后可查看附件列表。: This message has attachments. Load it to view the attachment list.
发送结果尚未确定。请核对邮箱中的已发送邮件，避免重复发送。: Delivery is unconfirmed. Check your sent mail before sending again.
补充缺少的资料，工作台将结合原邮件继续处理。: Provide the missing details to continue processing the original message.
例如：本次报价为…，交付日期为…: For example: the price is… and the delivery date is…
补充信息已保存，任务继续处理: Additional information saved. Processing will continue.
为这封邮件选择处理方案: Choose a workflow for this message
没有自动命中方案，可以指定一个已配置的方案开始处理。: No workflow matched automatically. Assign an existing workflow to start processing.
你可以继续处理其他任务，结果会自动更新。: Continue with other tasks. Results update automatically.
发送时使用标准邮件排版，可在「预览并发送」中查看。语气、语言和署名可在方案的处理: Standard email formatting is applied when sending. Check it in the send preview. Set tone, language and signature in the workflow instructions.
请先保存草稿修改，再添加附件。: Save draft changes before adding attachments.
每份草稿最多 10 个附件，请减少选择的文件数量。: A draft can have at most 10 attachments. Select fewer files.
本次选择的附件合计超过 20 MiB，请减少文件数量。: Selected attachments exceed 20 MiB. Select fewer files.
已添加 {0} 个附件，请在发送预览中下载检查。: Added {0} attachments. Download them from the send preview to review.
先保存草稿修改，再添加附件。: Save draft changes before adding attachments.
最多 10 个附件，全部附件合计不超过 20 MiB；邮箱配置可能设置更低上限。: Up to 10 attachments, totaling at most 20 MiB. Your mailbox may have a lower limit.
任务已更新。你的修改已保留，保存时将检查版本；请先核对新资料。: The task was updated. Your edits are preserved; saving will check the version. Review the latest information first.
放弃当前未保存的修改，并加载最新草稿？: Discard unsaved changes and load the latest draft?
处理完成后，摘要和草稿会显示在这里。: The summary and draft will appear here after processing.
已重新加入处理队列: Added back to the processing queue
请先保存修改再审核发送: Save changes before reviewing the message
选择一项任务，开始处理: Select a task to get started
在左侧选择任务，查看原邮件、处理结果和回复草稿。: Select a task on the left to view the message, results and reply draft.
页面关闭后继续运行，服务恢复后按游标补查新邮件。: Checks continue when this page is closed. New mail is caught up after service recovery.
匹配该邮箱的全部新邮件: Matches all new mail in this mailbox
让邮件自动进入你的工作流程: Bring incoming mail into your workflow
选择邮件范围，写下处理要求。工作台会生成结果，交给你审核。: Choose the mail scope and describe what to do. The workbench prepares results for your review.
多个方案命中时按优先级执行首个。方案更新仅用于后续执行，邮件发送始终需要你确认。: When multiple workflows match, the highest priority runs first. Changes apply to future executions. Sending always requires your confirmation.
首次检测会建立当前收件基线，仅处理之后到达的新邮件。若邮箱 UIDVALIDIT: The first check establishes a baseline; only later arrivals are processed. If UIDVALIDITY changes, verify the mailbox and rebuild the baseline.
开启自动处理后，可在此查看收件检测、任务执行和发送结果。: Enable processing to see mailbox checks, task execution and send results here.
请核对以下内容。点击“确认发送”后，邮件将提交至发件服务器。: Review the details below. “Confirm send” submits the message to the mail server.
有收件人命中禁止发送规则。请返回修改收件人，或在邮件插件中检查收件人策略。: A recipient is blocked by the sending policy. Edit recipients or review the policy in the email plugin.
预览已失效，请重新审核。: Preview expired. Review the message again.
任务或草稿已更新，请返回并重新审核最新内容。: The task or draft changed. Go back and review the latest version.
发送预览已过期，请返回并重新审核。: Send preview expired. Go back and review again.
附件已固定为本次预览快照。预览有效期为 10 分钟，修改草稿后需重新审核。: Attachments are fixed to this preview snapshot. It expires in 10 minutes. Review again after editing the draft.
发送预览缺少确认标识，请重新审核。: Send preview has no confirmation ID. Review again.
发送结果待核实，请先核对邮箱中的已发送邮件。工作台不会自动重发，请不要重复发送。: Delivery is unconfirmed. Check your sent mail first. The workbench will not resend automatically; avoid duplicate sends.
SMTP 返回部分收件人被拒绝，请查看任务中的发送回执并核对邮箱。工作台不会自动: SMTP rejected some recipients. Review the task's receipt and check your mailbox. The workbench will not resend automatically.
重建后，只会处理此刻之后到达的新邮件。当前文件夹内尚未进入工作台的邮件将跳过，已: Rebuilding processes only future arrivals. Existing messages not yet in the workbench are skipped. Tasks and history are retained. Verify the mailbox change first.
我已核对邮箱，确认跳过当前文件夹的已有邮件: I verified the mailbox and agree to skip existing messages in this folder
收件基线已重建，后续新邮件将按方案处理: Baseline rebuilt. Future arrivals will be processed by your workflows.
任务和处理记录会保留在“全部任务”中，不会删除原邮件。: The task and history remain in “All tasks”. The original message is retained.
未读取到 SMTP 回执详情。请核对邮箱记录，工作台不会自动重发。: SMTP receipt details are unavailable. Check your mailbox. The workbench will not resend automatically.
存在被服务器拒绝的收件人。已接受的地址可能已收到邮件，请核对下方名单及邮箱后单独: Some recipients were rejected. Accepted recipients may have received the message. Check the lists and your mailbox before handling rejected addresses separately; no automatic resend occurs.
回执中没有已接受的地址: No accepted addresses in the receipt
回执未提供响应文本: No response text in the receipt
服务器接受表示已提交发送，最终送达情况以收件方和邮箱投递记录为准。: Server acceptance confirms submission. Final delivery depends on the recipient and mailbox delivery records.
显示所有邮箱共有的文件夹。: Showing folders shared by all mailboxes.
从邮箱读取，默认使用收件箱，无需手工填写。: Folders are loaded from the mailbox. The inbox is selected by default.
一句话创建方案: Create a workflow in one sentence
说清楚哪些邮件、如何处理，AI 帮你整理成可核对的方案。: Describe which messages to handle and what to do. AI prepares a workflow for you to review.
用一句话描述邮件处理需求: Describe your mail workflow in one sentence
例如：收到主题包含“询价”的邮件，整理客户需求，生成礼貌的中文回复草稿，缺少价格: For example: for messages with “inquiry” in the subject, summarize the request and draft a polite English reply. Flag missing prices and delivery dates for review.
收到主题包含询价的邮件，整理客户需求并生成中文回复草稿，价格和交期缺少依据时交给: For messages with inquiry in the subject, summarize the customer's request and draft an English reply. Ask me to provide any missing prices or delivery dates.
收到带附件的邮件，阅读附件并整理关键信息，生成分析报告，缺少必要资料时列出待确认: For messages with attachments, read the attachments, summarize key information and create a report. Flag any missing information for review.
整理收件箱所有新邮件的事项和待办，只生成分析报告，不需要回复草稿。: Summarize the topics and action items in all new inbox messages. Create reports only, without reply drafts.
使用 DSH 已配置的模型。生成后核对并保存，才会启用。: Uses your configured DSH model. Review and save the generated workflow to enable it.
配置 DSH 默认模型后可使用 AI，也可直接手动填写。: Configure the default DSH model to use AI, or fill in the workflow manually.
方案草稿已生成，请核对邮件范围与处理要求后保存。: Workflow draft generated. Review the mail scope and instructions before saving.
可调整处理步骤、语言、语气与署名。: Customize steps, language, tone and signature.
说明收到邮件后需要做什么，以及缺少信息时如何处理。: Describe what to do when mail arrives and how to handle missing information.
此文件夹中的全部新邮件: All new mail in this folder
生成后由你审核并发送。: Review and send the generated draft.
生成后在任务中查看报告。: View the generated report in the task.
字符串包含，留空不限: Contains this text; leave blank for any sender
单个关键词，留空不限: One keyword; leave blank for any subject
逗号分隔，仅允许已安装的读取与查询工具。: Comma-separated. Only installed read and query tools are allowed.
选择已有邮件检查范围，不执行处理或发送邮件。: Check the scope against an existing message without processing or sending.
检测到邮件后即可测试: Testing is available after mail is detected
选择本次任务使用的技能，技能只能调用下方已允许的工具。: Choose skills for this task. Skills can only call the tools allowed below.
当前没有可供后台调用的技能，可直接使用处理要求。: No skills are available for background tasks. You can use the instructions directly.
只开放当前任务需要的读取与查询能力；留空时仅分析已有资料。: Allow only the read and query tools needed for this task. Leave blank to analyze existing information only.
当前没有可用的读取工具。请检查 DSH 工具配置。: No read tools are available. Check the DSH tool configuration.
